Name: Rotating Rugs
Author: pheauxm
Description:
Allows (most) nonrotatable vanilla rugs to be rotated.

Rugs included:
[list]
[*]Oceanic Rug
[*]Large Green Rug
[*]Icy Rug
[*]Old World Rug
[*]Large Red Rug
[*]Large Cottage Rug
[*]Blossom Rug
[*]Funky Rug
[*]Modern Rug
[*]Large Joja Rug
[*]Small Joja Rug
[*]Small Junimo Mat
[*]Junimo Rug
[*]Retro Mat
[*]Large Retro Rug
[*]Starry Moon Rug
[/list]
The Stone Flooring rug can't be rotated as is, but a second Stone Flooring rug that is a rotated version is added (it should appear right below the Stone Flooring Rug in the Wizard Catalogue).

Limitations:
Rotations act weird when a rug is rotated 4 ways, so they're all limited to just 1 additional rotation. Square-tiled rugs (so rugs that take up 2x2/3x3/etc tiles) don't rotate at all, hence a new Stone Flooring Rug being added altogether. I don't know C# (yet), so this is all limited by what I can change via the json files (for now).
